skills.name: Visual Design, Form Controls and Responsive Layout
skills.capability: Applies the PRD design tokens, flat card, typography, results list, form controls and Calculate/Clear buttons in a mobile-first layout that has no horizontal scroll from 320px to 1920px.
skills.prompt_template: You are implementing the full visual layer of the cart calculator in public/styles.css (plus minimal semantic changes in public/index.html), with no external fonts, CDNs, @import or frameworks. Write mobile-first CSS with the 320px layout as the base and box-sizing border-box. Use page background #F6F7F9, text #1A1A1A, a system font stack and a 16px minimum base size. Style the card flat with a 1px #E3E6EB border, a soft shadow, a 12px radius, width 100% and max-width 420px, centered horizontally and placed near the top of the page (not vertically centered), with 16px side padding on a 4/8px spacing scale. Style the h1 at 24px/600 and secondary text in muted #5B6470. Style the results as a definition-style list: label on the left, amount right-aligned, a 1px divider above Total, Total at 32px/700 with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums, long amounts wrapping without overflow, and the discount amount in #067647 (the 'discount applied' / 'No discount applied' text must remain so color is never the only signal). Place labels above the fields at 16px; make inputs 48px tall with an 8px radius, a visible neutral border, 16px font size and full width. Show error text below each field in #B42318 and give inputs with aria-invalid='true' a #B42318 border. Make the Calculate button full-width, 48px tall, background #1F5EFF with white text, an 8px radius and a darker hover/active shade, and make the Clear button an outlined secondary (transparent background, 1px #1F5EFF border and text, same height and radius). Ensure the viewport meta tag (width=device-width, initial-scale=1) is present, use only min-width media queries, and keep every control at least 44x44px. Reuse the existing markup and class names.
acceptance_criteria: public/styles.css sets body background #F6F7F9 and text color #1A1A1A, and contains no @import, url(http...) or external font references
The card rule has border 1px solid #E3E6EB, border-radius 12px, a box-shadow and max-width 420px; at 1280px the card is no wider than 420px and its top edge is within 120px of the viewport top
The h1 computed style is font-size 24px and font-weight 600; the Total element has font-size 32px, font-weight 700 and font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums
The discount amount uses color #067647 and its row also contains the text 'discount applied' or 'No discount applied'
After a successful calculation, the results list shows labels on the left, amounts right-aligned and a divider line above Total

Computed height of the Price input, Quantity input, Calculate button and Clear button is at least 48px; inputs have border-radius 8px and computed font-size of at least 16px; each label renders above its input

The Calculate button has background-color #1F5EFF, white text and fills the full card content width; its :hover rule defines a darker background; the Clear button has a transparent background and a visible 1px border

An input with aria-invalid='true' renders a #B42318 border and its error text element has color #B42318; submitting empty fields in the running app shows red-bordered inputs with red error text directly below each field
index.html contains <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"> and styles.css uses min-width media queries rather than max-width queries for layout
At viewport widths 320, 375, 768, 1280 and 1920px, document.documentElement.scrollWidth is not greater than window.innerWidth
At 320px, the card has at least 8px of margin on each side, the Total amount '1,000,000.00' does not overflow the card, and every input and button has a bounding box of at least 44x44px

skills.name: Accessibility, Focus States and Lighthouse Verification
skills.tool: HTML (public/index.html), CSS (public/styles.css), WCAG contrast calculation, Lighthouse CLI, README
skills.capability: Ensures semantic HTML, visible focus rings, reduced-motion support, WCAG 2.1 AA contrast and keyboard operability, and records Lighthouse and keyboard walkthrough results.
skills.prompt_template: You are making the cart calculator accessible and verifying it, in public/index.html and public/styles.css without changing calculation behavior. Ensure <html lang="en">, a non-empty <title>, a single <main> containing one <h1> and a <form> with labels tied to inputs via for/id, a DOM order that gives the tab order Price, Quantity, Calculate, Clear, and no tabindex above 0. Add a :focus-visible rule for inputs, buttons and any other interactive element with a 2px solid #1F5EFF outline and a 2px outline-offset, never removing an outline without a replacement. Keep transitions short and add a @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) block that disables transitions and animations. Verify that every text/background pair (body text, muted #5B6470, #B42318 errors, #067647 discount text, white on #1F5EFF, Clear button text, and the savings line and threshold hint if present) has a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1, adjusting colors minimally only if one fails; errors and discounts must keep explanatory text. Then start the server, run Lighthouse (mobile profile, Fast 3G throttling) using npx or a devDependency only, fix any failures minimally, perform a keyboard-only walkthrough (Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter, Space: calculate, trigger an error and land on the first invalid field, Clear and return to Price), and record the Lighthouse scores, FCP and walkthrough results in a 'Verification' section of the README.
acceptance_criteria: index.html has <html lang="en">, a non-empty <title>, exactly one <main>, exactly one <h1> and a <form> element; each input has a <label> whose for attribute matches the input id
No element has a tabindex greater than 0, and the keyboard tab order in the running app is Price, Quantity, Calculate, Clear with no keyboard trap

styles.css has a :focus-visible rule giving inputs and buttons outline: 2px solid #1F5EFF and outline-offset: 2px, and no rule sets outline: none or outline: 0 on an interactive element without a replacement indicator
A @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) block sets transition and animation to none or a near-zero duration
The computed contrast ratio is at least 4.5:1 for #1A1A1A on #F6F7F9, #5B6470 on white and on #F6F7F9, #B42318 on white, #067647 on white, and white on #1F5EFF
Pressing Enter in the Price or Quantity field triggers the calculation, and every control can be operated by keyboard alone
Lighthouse on / reports an Accessibility score of at least 95 with no failing color-contrast, label, lang or landmark audits, and FCP of at most 1.5 s on the Fast 3G profile

README.md has a Verification section listing the Lighthouse Accessibility score, the FCP value and a pass result for each keyboard walkthrough step: Tab order, Enter-to-calculate, error focus on the first invalid field, and Clear returning focus to Price
package.json runtime dependencies still contain only express, and `npm test` passes
